high_level_description: This image captures a stunning display of the Northern Lights (Aurora Borealis) in a night sky. The aurora is predominantly pink and green, with the pink hues being more prominent in the center and transitioning to green towards the edges. The sky is dotted with stars, adding to the celestial beauty of the scene. In the foreground, there are silhouettes of trees and what appears to be a body of water, possibly a lake or river, reflecting the colors of the aurora. The trees are dark against the illuminated sky, creating a stark contrast that highlights the vibrant colors of the aurora.
